steps.title: Domains and TLS
steps.subtitle: Match your public hostname to Outline's URL setting.

steps.title: Reverse proxy
steps.subtitle: Point BunkerWeb at Outline and upgrade its realtime sockets; set PROXY_IP_HEADER=X-Real-IP in Outline.

steps.title: Cookies, request rate and body sizes
steps.subtitle: Let the editor read its CSRF cookie (every other cookie keeps HttpOnly), load without throttling and save large documents.

steps.title: HTTP - Live editing connections
steps.subtitle: Allow two sockets per open document for every user behind one address.

steps.title: Security - Browser features
steps.subtitle: Allow presentation mode, embed fullscreen and passkey sign-in that BunkerWeb's default policy blocks.

steps.title: Security - ChatGPT MCP connector
steps.subtitle: Let ChatGPT's connector past the user-agent blacklist; drop it if you do not use ChatGPT.

steps.title: Security - Review wiki text CRS exclusions
steps.subtitle: Skip injection rules for document text, titles, search, comments, Slack search, MCP and OAuth redirect URIs.
